_meta.title: rustypi Feature Tracker
_meta.description: Tracks feature status for the rustypi Rust coding agent

features.name: Project Setup & Baseline
features.description: Confirm cargo build, cargo test, ./init.sh, and --self-test all pass from a clean checkout
features.evidence: cargo build --release (2.6 MB), cargo test passes, --self-test passes

features.name: Core Agent Loop
features.description: System prompt → user task → LLM tool calls → tool execution → feedback loop terminates correctly
features.evidence: run_agent in ai_core/mod.rs, verified by --self-test (fake SSE server)

features.name: LLM Streaming & SSE
features.description: Streaming responses via reqwest SSE, JSON fragment accumulation for tool-call arguments
features.evidence:
chat_stream in ai_core/llm.rs, handles 

 and 

 delimiters, per-index argument accumulation

features.name: Tool Implementations
features.description: read_file, write_file, edit_file, run_command, ask_user tools work correctly and report errors
features.evidence: ai_core/tools.rs, the original 5 tools; edit_file enforces a unique match, run_command is platform-aware. Extended by feat-021 (grep/glob/list_dir/multi_edit, ranged reads, timeout) and feat-023 (delete/move, background jobs, todo, delegate, permission gate, root guard) — 16 tools total

features.name: Model Config & CLI
features.description: model.json persistence, --list, --use, --add, --url/--key/--model flags, LLM_URL/LLM_KEY/LLM_MODEL env vars
features.evidence: config.rs, interactive add when empty, EOF-safe prompts, profiles with default pointer

features.name: TUI Mode
features.description: --tui flag launches pi-style main-screen TUI with synchronized output (CSI 2026), differential rendering, live streaming transcript, ask_user input box, Esc quits
features.evidence: src/tui/ module (mod/app/render/plain), main-screen (no alternate screen), diff rendering with RenderState, CSI 2026 for atomic frames, plain stream fallback for piped stdin

features.name: Self-Test
features.description: --self-test runs offline check with fake server, no network required
features.evidence: ai_core/mod.rs self_test(), fake SSE server with 2 requests, sync tool assertions, session tree checks

features.name: Session Persistence & Tree Branching
features.description: session.json with tree structure (id/parentId), active leaf, --tree browser (pi-style main-screen + diff rendering), --resume, pi-style branching
features.evidence: session.rs (Entry/Session), tree.rs (main-screen diff renderer + plain list), --tree/--resume in main.rs

features.name: Live LLM Integration
features.description: Tested against local LLM server (localhost:20128), model profiles with API key, streaming works end-to-end
features.evidence: model.json with mimo-v2.5-pro default, key persisted, streaming verified via curl and rustypi CLI

features.name: TUI Experience: semantic status + spinner + editing + scrollback + slash commands
features.description: Semantic status symbols/colors (⠋ working, ✓ success, ✗ failure, ⚠ warn, ℹ info, cyan › prompt), animated spinner, cursor editing + history recall, PageUp/PageDown scrollback, /use /resume /tree slash commands, input overflow window, user lines flush-left with dim number + cyan caret
features.evidence: tools.rs returns (bool,String); Event::ToolStart/ToolEnd/TaskEnd; Job enum (Task/Model/Resume/Tree); cursor/history/scroll fields in App; SPINNER frames in render.rs; colorize_row semantic colors; self-test green

features.name: Interrupt Key Model (pi-style)
features.description: Esc interrupts the running agent (cooperative AtomicBool checked between iterations and per stream chunk), Ctrl+C clears input, Ctrl+D exits when input empty; interrupted turns show '⚠ interrupted'; quit no longer waits for in-flight turn
features.evidence: cancel: Arc<AtomicBool> shared TUI<->agent; run_agent/chat_stream take &AtomicBool; self-test asserts pre-set flag returns Err("interrupted") before any network call

features.name: /reload: hot rebuild + relaunch
features.description: TUI slash command rebuilds rustypi from its own source (CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR) into target/reload, runs a uniquely-named copy of the binary (never the built file itself, so cargo can always overwrite it despite Windows exe-locking), and relaunches: exec on Unix, wait-as-thin-wrapper on Windows (exiting after spawn would let the shell fight the child for console input). Preserves the session (saved first, then --resume), live model (--url/--key/--model, survives a mid-session /use), and visible transcript (reconstructed from session.json on the new process). Guarded to idle turns only; build failures leave the running session untouched. /model lists saved profiles (active marked) or switches by name.
features.evidence: tui/mod.rs: Job::Reload, stage_reload_exe/build_relaunch_args/render_history (latter two unit tested), Event::Reload handoff, cfg(unix) exec vs cfg(not(unix)) status(); app.rs: Exit::Reload return from ui_loop, /reload gated on app.done, /model + shared switch_model/list_models; fixed pre-existing job_tx/join deadlock on quit and a blocking stdin prompt under --tui --resume as prerequisites; ai_core: resumed session's system entry refreshed from SYSTEM_PROMPT each turn; verified: cargo build into target/reload + staged copy runs --self-test

features.name: Tool wall time
features.description: Every finished tool row carries its own wall time (✓ src/main.rs  450ms); Event::ToolEnd gained an ms field, measured around dispatch in run_agent and around the cargo build in /reload
features.evidence: ai_core::took unit-checked in --self-test; visible as '✓ echo hi  15ms' in --self-test output

features.name: Ctrl+C twice to exit
features.description: First Ctrl+C clears the input and cancels a running turn, a second within 2s quits; status line shows 'press ctrl+c again to exit' in yellow while armed, any other key disarms. /quit added as the explicit equivalent
features.evidence: cargo build clean; App::armed drives the status line; /quit returns Exit::Quit from handle_command

features.name: Per-turn token/tps/wall stats
features.description: After each turn: '· 142 tok · 38.4 tps · 6.2s', dim. Tokens come from the server's usage.completion_tokens when sent, else a chars/4 estimate marked with '~'; tps is over generation time only (clock starts at the first token) so tool waits don't dilute it
features.evidence: tui::tests::turn_stats_row_reports_tps_over_generation_time_only

features.name: reasoning_content thinking block
features.description: Thinking models' reasoning_content (or reasoning) deltas stream into a dim '│ ' block that closes when the answer or a tool call starts; never folded into content or sent back to the model. Plain mode writes it to stderr
features.evidence: --self-test fake SSE stream includes a reasoning_content delta; final content stays exactly 'done'

features.name: Slash-command menu
features.description: Typing a lone '/word' opens the command menu above the input: 5 rows visible, up/down walks the whole filtered list, Tab completes, Enter runs, Esc dismisses for that text, 'n/total' counter row when it overflows. Queued commands (/undo /commit /plan /test /export) are listed with '· soon' and print a pointer to harness/open-work.md when run
features.evidence: tui::tests::slash_menu_filters_on_prefix_and_closes_once_args_start

features.name: Named sessions + /resume picker
features.description: --session NAME (or RUSTYPI_SESSION) stores a session at .rustypi/sessions/NAME.json, the root session.json staying the unnamed default. /resume with no argument opens an arrow-driven picker (name, entries, relative age, latest user message); /resume 2 or /resume NAME skips it. Resuming replaces the on-screen transcript and recallable history via Event::Resumed
features.evidence: session::tests::info_reports_entry_count_and_latest_user_message; tests::task_arg_skips_flag_values; smoke: rustypi --session smoke "..." wrote .rustypi/sessions/smoke.json and answered

features.name: Active session name in status line
features.description: The status line's right slot reads '<session> · <model>' (prototype shows the name in its title bar); seeded from the session file's stem, updated by Event::SessionName on resume and rename
features.evidence: cargo build clean; name_of() covered by session::tests; visible as 'two · Qwen/...' when launched with --session two

features.name: /rename <new-name>
features.description: Renames the active session's file to .rustypi/sessions/<name>.json: ASCII letters/digits/._- up to 40 chars, refuses a taken name or the current one, moves the file when it exists (an unsaved session just repoints), prints 'ℹ renamed old → new'. /reload's relaunch argv now carries the live session name so a rename survives a hot rebuild. /session list|switch listed in the menu as '· soon'
features.evidence: tui::tests::rename_moves_the_session_file_and_refuses_bad_or_taken_names; session::tests covers valid_name; tui::tests::relaunch_args_replace_model_and_dedupe_resume asserts the --session pair is replaced

features.name: Native Search & Edit Tools
features.description: grep (ripgrep when installed, std substring fallback), glob (rg --files or std walk + own matcher), list_dir (depth, skip list), read_file offset/limit with line numbers, multi_edit all-or-nothing, run_command timeout_secs (default 120, kill at deadline)
features.evidence: --self-test asserts glob_match cases, list_dir/glob/grep on the repo, ranged read, multi_edit atomicity, 1s timeout kills ping/sleep; passes with rg on PATH and with PATH=System32 (fallback path)

features.name: Iteration Cap & Project Instructions
features.description: MAX_ITERS 10 -> 50, overridable with --max-iters N / RUSTYPI_MAX_ITERS; system prompt appends AGENTS.md (fallback RUSTYPI.md, CLAUDE.md) from cwd, re-read every turn so edits are live, capped at 20k chars
features.evidence: --self-test: set_max_iters floor, instructions_from precedence (AGENTS.md > RUSTYPI.md, blank file skipped), system_prompt starts with SYSTEM_PROMPT

features.name: Agent Safety & Workflow Tools
features.description: Permission gate on write/edit/multi_edit/run_command/run_background/delete/move via Event::Ask (y / n / a=always for that tool), --yolo or RUSTYPI_YOLO=1 skips; project-root guard on all write paths (canonicalized deepest-existing ancestor, refuses ../ and absolute-outside); delete_file, move_file; run_background + job_output + job_stop (taskkill /T on Windows); todo list tool rendered to the transcript; delegate(task) runs a one-level sub-agent in its own .rustypi/sessions/sub-*.json and returns only its report
features.evidence: --self-test: decide() y/yes/a/always/deny, guard() inside vs ../ vs temp dir, write refused outside root, move/delete roundtrip, background job running->stopped and echo job exited 0 with output, todo render; 0 warnings; cargo test 7 passed

features.name: TUI Markdown Rendering
features.description: Model prose renders markdown in the TUI: ATX headings, **bold**, `inline code`, - / * bullets as bullet glyphs, and fenced code blocks. No parser crate; markers are stripped and turned into style runs over the visible text so wrapping measures real columns. Fenced bodies are truncated, never reflowed. Tool rows, user queries, reasoning and stats keep their own styling
features.evidence: render.rs tests markdown_markers_become_styling_not_literal_characters and markdown_wrapping_measures_visible_text_not_markers; cargo test 12 passed
